name: Log1p Bank bounded fixed-configuration checkpoint comparison v1
initialization: Every replica independently starts at its own target mode. Original counter RNG paired by seed,replica,iteration,purpose across methods.
metric: Endpoint standardized slicedW2 and relative ergodic variance NRMSE; mean over8 seeds separately for each fixed reference, worse of two reference means. Unchanged definitions.
failure_rule: Any failed replica in any seed through512 invalidates the method/config at every checkpoint. All failures retained; never score survivors.
time: Local stored anchor attribution + actual per-run prepare/state setup + synchronized compiled sampling including RNG. Cold adds compile per shape. Functionals/scoring/I/O excluded equally, separately recorded. Cache/order effects mean cold is not fresh-process cold.
first_attainment: Earliest tested checkpoint with both aggregate metrics passing; no interpolation and no global tuning claim. At128 reached means true first attainment is left-censored <=128; none through512 is Not Reached.
uncertainty: Paired whole-seed bootstrap preserves methods,checkpoints,references. Pointwise percentile95% CIs for metrics/time and paired differences; no multiplicity correction. Recompute earliest crossing per draw and retain Not Reached mass. Speedup CI on jointly attained draws is conditional, explicitly report fraction; no finite ratio when point comparison unavailable.
scope: Exploratory independent follow-up to observed feature sensitivity; thresholds fixed, no new reference or parameters. Four checkpoints only. Stop after these16 runs; no P3B.
